newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber edges lower in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber edges lower in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures edged lower in after-hours trade on Wednesday following modest gains during the day, as Monday's bullishly construed Japan stock report continued to buoy sentiment, market sources said. This week's light gains were seen limited, however, amid expectations that stocks would continue climbing in the longer term.
Benchmark March was at 134.1 yen per kg, off 0.1 yen from the day's close, while the nearby months were 0.3 weaker to 0.4 firmer. The day's volume was termed moderate at 6,046 lots.
The market will be closed on Thursday for Sports Day.
